summary: Cerus Corporation filed a Form 8-K on June 8, 2026, reporting entry into a Second Amended and Restated Credit, Security and Guaranty Agreement (Term Loan) and a Second Amended and Restated Credit, Security and Guaranty Agreement (Revolving Loan) on June 5, 2026. These agreements amend and restate existing credit facilities with MidCap Financial Trust and MidCap Funding IV Trust. The Term Loan Credit Agreement provides a secured term loan facility of up to $65.0 million, with an initial $35.0 million draw to refinance existing term loans. Additional tranches up to $30.0 million are available for working capital and general corporate purposes. Interest is Term SOFR plus 5.50% (1.00% floor). Interest-only payments apply for 48 months then 12 months of amortization. No early termination fee after one year. This is a routine refinancing and credit facility amendment, not a special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, or activist campaign.
